dedupe_keys.name: geolab safety centrifuge tests of dry stack tailings storage facility stability deltares and university of porto

description: Measurement data from geotechnical centrifuge tests of dry-stack tailings embankments, carried out at Deltares' centrifuge facilities under the GEOLAB Transnational Access project SAFETY (Stability Analysis For Enhanced Tailings storage facilities), coordinated by the University of Porto. The Zenodo record says the project evaluates the stability of tailings storage facilities under adverse conditions, such as liquefaction, and focuses on dry stacking as a potentially safer disposal method. Published on 13 January 2025 by C. Cengiz (Deltares) and Sara Rios (University of Porto), it holds six MATLAB .MAT files at 100 Hz for Test 01 (spin-up, cone penetration test and phases A to D) and a GEOLAB data storage report, about 517 MB in all, free under CC BY 4.0; a later version exists. Caveats: it covers one test series at model scale, and the report must be read to interpret channels and scaling. For simulation it gives physical test data to calibrate or validate numerical models of tailings embankment stability and liquefaction. Related catalogue records include the global databases of tailings dam failures and the Global Tailings Portal.
